is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles coluzzii and Anopheles gambiae (page 56, Abstract; page 57).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Analyzed Vgsc L1014F (L995F) and L1014S (L995S) frequencies from Pool-Seq data across colonies and backcrossed lines (page 62, 'Kdr mutation frequencies in TG_BC6 offspring'; page 66).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or sample sizes for field-collected mosquitoes are reported. Kdr mutation frequencies were only estimated from whole-genome pooled sequencing (Pool-Seq) of laboratory colonies and laboratory backcross generations (page 62, page 66).

african_field_population.evidence: All genotyped mosquitoes were laboratory strains/colonies (Ag(PMB)1 derived from G3, Mali-NIH colonized in 2005, and BF_Ac(WT) colonized in 2014) and their experimental laboratory backcrossed progeny (pages 57, 65). No field-caught adults (F0), field-collected larvae/pupae, or F1 progeny of wild females were tested.

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical laboratory introgression and genomics study.

sub_country_location.evidence: Origin locations of recipient colonies are stated: Niono, Mali and Vallee Du Kou, Bama, Burkina Faso (page 65).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Colony collection dates are stated as June 2005 (Mali) and 2014 (Burkina Faso), and introgression experiments occurred from 2018 to 2019 (page 65).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine laboratory experimental cross study using established BEI and IRSS colonies.

supplement.evidence: The paper exclusively analyzes laboratory colonies and their backcross generations, so supplementary data would not make it eligible under the field population criterion.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the introgression of a synthetic sex-ratio distorter transgene into laboratory-adapted genetic backgrounds of Anopheles coluzzii (colonies originating from Mali and Burkina Faso) over multiple backcross generations. Although Vgsc L1014F and L1014S frequencies were inferred from Pool-Seq data, no African field populations were tested (only colonized strains and laboratory crosses).
exclusion_reasons: african_field_population: only laboratory colonies (G3, Mali-NIH, BF_Ac(WT)) and their laboratory backcross progeny were genotyped; no African field mosquitoes (F0/F1) were tested.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: no extractable genotype or allele counts for field populations.
